title: Integrate VerseGuide location data when API available
description: VerseGuide (verseguide.com) is a community-driven planetary location database for Star Citizen covering Stanton, Pyro, and Nyx. It has POIs, outposts, caves, creature spawns, and detailed location info that could improve our item→source mappings. Their API is currently under development. When available, integrate to: (1) validate/enrich existing source location data, (2) add coordinates and richer location metadata. Check https://verseguide.com/apps periodically for API availability.
